bull.b: Sustained high operating and free cash flow provides durable financial flexibility: funds R&D, strategic M&A, and marketplace investments without reliance on external financing, reduces refinancing risk and supports long-term scaling of the subscription model and capital-intensive AI/security initiatives.

bull.t: Revenue scale and high gross margins (ARR strength)
bull.b: Large recurring ARR and consistently high gross margins reflect a scalable cloud-native security platform with sticky subscription economics. Strong ARR growth and sizable revenue scale underpin predictable renewal streams and cross-sell potential, supporting durable margin leverage as sales efficiency improves.

bull.t: Enterprise adoption and marketplace GTM momentum
bull.b: Rising large-account wins and accelerating marketplace/TCV activity signal durable go-to-market scale and partner-led distribution. Large ACVs increase revenue stickiness, raise customer lifetime value, and create structural upsell channels that support sustained multiyear growth and margin improvement.

bear.b: A structural slowdown to mid-teens growth reduces the tailwind of high organic expansion and tightens the path to scale-driven profitability. Slower net new ARR growth limits operating leverage, forces longer payback on sales investments, and raises the bar for sustaining current margin gains.

Persistent GAAP losses indicate reliance on non-GAAP adjustments and ongoing heavy investment; until GAAP profits are consistent, capital allocation may stay conservative and some stakeholders may question sustainability of returns despite strong cash flow, slowing the shift to fully durable operating profitability.

bear.t: Sales leadership turnover and rising CapEx compressing FCF
bear.b: Leadership churn risks disruption to deal-closing and new-logo acquisition at a time when management is increasing CapEx. Pulled-forward equipment purchases and higher FY27 CapEx expectations can reduce free cash flow margins and temporarily impair reinvestment efficiency and sales momentum.
